description: Fix the blank-page crash in ClientLayout.jsx (missing MessageSquare import causes ReferenceError) and redesign it as a full sidebar layout matching the therapist Sidebar.jsx pattern but teal-branded for clients. This FEAT is the critical prerequisite for all others — nothing in the client portal is visible until this crash is fixed.
steps: Open frontend/src/layouts/ClientLayout.jsx. The current file imports Calendar, FileText, CreditCard, LogOut, HeartHandshake from lucide-react but uses MessageSquare in JSX without importing it — this is the crash.

Rewrite ClientLayout.jsx completely as a sidebar layout. Model the structure after frontend/src/components/common/Sidebar.jsx. Key differences: teal brand colors (teal-600 / teal-50 / teal-700) instead of primary blue, client-specific nav items, no FeedbackModal, no subscription block at bottom. Use useState for mobile drawer open/close. Use useLocation to close drawer on route change (useEffect with location.pathname dep). Export nothing except the default component.

Nav items array (defined inside or above the component): [{ name: 'Dashboard', path: '/client', icon: LayoutDashboard, end: true }, { name: 'Bookings', path: '/client/bookings', icon: Calendar }, { name: 'Chat', path: '/client/chat', icon: MessageSquare }, { name: 'Payments', path: '/client/payments', icon: CreditCard }, { name: 'Notes', path: '/client/notes', icon: FileText }, { name: 'Profile', path: '/client/profile', icon: UserCircle }]

Import list for ClientLayout.jsx: React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { Outlet, NavLink, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'; { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; { LayoutDashboard, Calendar, MessageSquare, CreditCard, FileText, UserCircle, LogOut, HeartHandshake, X, Menu } from 'lucide-react'.

Desktop layout: fixed left sidebar 256px wide (w-64), full-screen height, white bg, right border slate-200. Top section: teal-600 HeartHandshake icon in a w-9 h-9 rounded-lg, 'Unfazed' bold text, 'Client Portal' subtext in teal-600. Nav section: flex-1 overflow-y-auto, map navItems with NavLink. Active state: bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 font-semibold. Inactive: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50. Bottom section: user avatar (first letter in teal-600 circle), name + email truncated, LogOut button. Main content area: ml-64 (desktop), full width mobile, min-h-screen bg-slate-50. Render <Outlet /> inside a <main> with px-4 sm:px-6 py-8.

Mobile layout: sticky top header (h-16, white, border-b) with hamburger Menu icon on the left and 'Client Portal' title. Clicking hamburger sets drawerOpen=true. Overlay backdrop + slide-in drawer (same pattern as Sidebar.jsx: fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-40 backdrop-blur-sm for backdrop; w-72 fixed left-0 top-0 h-full z-50 transform transition-transform, translate-x-0 when open, -translate-x-full when closed). Drawer contains same SidebarContent. X button inside drawer header closes it.
No changes to AppRoutes.jsx in this FEAT — routes are wired in FEAT-003.
acceptance_criteria: cd frontend && npm run build exits 0 with no errors after this change (proves the missing import crash is fixed)
Navigating to /client in the browser shows a teal sidebar on desktop with all 6 nav links visible
Clicking each nav link highlights it as active and does not crash the page
On mobile viewport the hamburger opens the drawer and the X/backdrop closes it
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — must exit 0 with no import/ReferenceError
findings: Root crash was MessageSquare used in JSX but missing from lucide-react import. Rewrote ClientLayout.jsx as a full teal-branded sidebar layout matching Sidebar.jsx pattern: fixed 256px desktop sidebar, mobile sticky header + hamburger + slide-in drawer, 6 nav items (Dashboard/Bookings/Chat/Payments/Notes/Profile), useLocation drawer-close on route change, user avatar + logout at sidebar bottom. Build exits 0 (✓ built in 31.23s, no errors, only expected chunk-size warning).
